content:
**The Trading Post** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

Prior to the apperance of The Storm, this location was a highly frequented stop for all sorts of traders, and also produced Maple Syrup, won from the huge tree in the center of the camp. [1] [2] The camp was previously occupied by a group led by James, most of which decided to move northwards, in an attempt to escape the storm and build a new camp. [3] [4] [5] [6] [7] 

Accessible via a dirt road with numerous signs, which splits off from the road northeast of the location, this small camp has a a massive tree in the center and several makeshift stalls and Caravans surrounding it. On the ground around the tree is a wooden platform, which houses an Ammo Storage Box, Ammunition Vending Machine, Armor Workbench, Cooking Station, Donations Box, Legendary Exchange Machine, Medical Supplies Vending Machine, Power Armor Station, Punch Card Machine, Scrapbox, Tinker's Workbench, and Weapons Workbench.

West of the tree is a small, tarp-covered tent with a Radstag corpse on a table, a Cooking Station and a "Mess Hall" tent with several tables, two more Cooking Stations, and a sign advertising "Tato Venison and Stew" as today's special. To the right of the Mess Hall is a Caravan with several wooden boxes and an empty Protectron Pod.

North of the tree are a couple of stairs that lead up to an area with minor loot and two more Caravans. The northwestern Caravan contains a Duffle Bag and the dead body of Wesley on the ground. The northeastern Caravan contains a Bed, Safe, and Jewel's Note on a desk.

To the east of the tree are two Caravans, one of which is turned on its side. The other has a Chemistry Station and a Stash Box in front of it, as well as a First Aid box inside it.

The Trading Post appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.
